snippet.title: Hachi Eight Feet Tall - Gameplay Walkthrough FULL GAME No Commentary
snippet.description:
Curious about the forest her grandparents strictly forbade, Miyu wandered in—only to be ambushed by something inhuman. Haunted by the towering figure of Hachishakusama, Miyu must uncover the truth and perform the final ritual… before the voice behind the door calls her again.
